en.html:
About three minutes after leaving Yokohama, I sighted the enormous helium balloon swimming through the sky.

Our speed in finding it was not due only to the earlier prediction that it would head straight for its destination. A ship of that kind could not disregard the wind. Depending on its direction, it might be driven far off course.

In fact, the vessel lay somewhat south of its planned course. That we had wasted no time searching owed much to old Nagakura: she had anticipated this and prepared a transmitter.

Soon after leaving Yokohama, we had received the signal from the Captain and her attendant, already aboard. After that, we could follow it. Prediction and Muramasa’s <ruby>search<rt>radar</rt></ruby> alone would have taken longer.

Three minutes was the <ruby>best result<rt>best</rt></ruby> we could ask for.
I wanted our entry to be equally prompt, and not waste it—but—

ja.html:
横浜から飛び立って約三分。
　空を泳ぐ巨大なヘリウム風船を肉眼で確認する。

　この早さは飛行艦が目的地へ直進するという事前の
推測のみに起因しない。
　飛行艦は風を無視しては飛べない器械だ。風向次第
では針路を大きく逸らす事態も起こり得た。

　実際、船は予定針路をやや南へ外れている。
　さりながら捜索に時間を浪費しなかったのは、かく
あるを読んで永倉老が発信機を用意した事こそ大きい。

　船内に潜入済みの大鳥主従が発する信号を横浜出立
から間もなくして受信し、後はそれを辿って追う事が
できたのだった。
　予測と村正の<ruby>探査<rt>レーダー</rt></ruby>のみではもっと時間を食ったろう。

　三分での捕捉は<ruby>最善<rt>ベスト</rt></ruby>といえる。
　この折角の成果を無駄にしないため、突入も手早く
済ませてしまいたいが――

en.html:
Pierced by a spear of dread, I stopped the armor’s self-reproach.
If anyone had gone senile, it was I.

Captain Ootori had told me—a UNIT of stealth dragoons already existed!

Only one would be used on this operation. It would only drop the bomb; none would act as <ruby>unseen escorts<rt>・・・・・・・</rt></ruby> for the airship—

When had anyone promised me that!? Who had promised it!?

There were limits to being a fool...!

　大鳥大尉は俺に教えていたのだ――
　隠形竜騎兵の『部隊』が既に存在すると！

　この作戦に使われるのはそのうち一騎だけ、爆弾の
投下に利用されるだけで、飛行艦の<ruby>見えざる護衛騎<rt>・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>と
して用いられることなどない――
　そんな約束をいつ、誰が、俺にしたのか!?

　間を抜かすにも程がある……！

en.html:
Two armored silhouettes approached. Their movements made plain both the pilots’ skill and the machines’ performance.

Both were extremely high.
Naturally—the former were personnel Lieutenant Colonel Cannon had entrusted with part of a top-secret mission; the latter, the League forces’ newest ST-09s.

They deserved the name <ruby>Devils of the Sky<rt>Winged Demon</rt></ruby>.
Under these circumstances, they were not opponents we could remain and fight.
